name: chat-plan-card
title: Chat Plan Card
description: A plan an agent wants approved, as a document inside the turn — steps, Will change, Won't, Needs your OK and what changed since the last version (ChatPlanCard) — and the line it settles into (PlanLine).

meta.whenToUse: A plan waiting for a person's approval in an agent chat, and its approved, rejected or replaced line.
meta.whenNotToUse: The task list a running plan becomes (TaskList); a static checklist in a document.
